facts.text: The XY stage and focus device labels are read from the Micro-Manager core when stage.py is imported, beside the hard-coded ASI labels ASI-XYStage and XStage
send_serial_command_to_stage sends a serial command to the ASI Tiger console only after core.wait_for_device(XY_STAGE_NAME) returns
The X and Z stages are swapped, so the X-axis speed is set with the Z-axis SPEED command
set_x_position takes x_pos in micrometres, waits for the XY stage, sets the default X speed and sends M Z=<int(x_pos)*TO_TENTHS>, the ASI MOVE command in tenths of microns
set_y_position takes y_pos in micrometres, waits for the XY stage, sets the default Y speed and sends M Y=<int(y_pos)*TO_TENTHS>
set_z_position takes z_pos in micrometres, waits for the Z stage, sets the default Z speed and passes z_pos unchanged to core.set_position(Z_STAGE_NAME, z_pos)
get_x_position, get_y_position and get_z_position wait for their stage and return the core position truncated to int

move_stage moves Z before XY when the current X is greater than the target X, and XY before Z otherwise; its comment says this keeps capillaries from hitting the objective and that the conditions should match the geometry of the holder
wait_for_xy_stage and wait_for_z_stage block on the Micro-Manager core until the stage is not busy

reset_stage sends RESET through send_serial_command_to_stage; its docstring says RESET resets the current flash memory of the Tiger console, most notably the origin (to its current position) and the joystick settings, and marks the function DEPRECATED
general_exception_handle runs a hardware function up to two times, logging each exception; after the second failure it prints a message and raises GeneralHardwareException
Importing the hardware package sets the camera to its default mode and initializes the PLC state, suppressing GeneralHardwareException
default_mode stops sequence acquisition, turns live mode off and sets the camera trigger mode, acquire mode and exposure
init_plc_state programs the PLC circuit used in z-stack acquisition and lsrm, whose pulse is sent to the camera as an external trigger
utils.pycro constructs the pycromanager Studio and Core objects when it is imported
init_logger creates a logs directory in the current directory and calls logging.basicConfig with a DEBUG log file there
_abort_acquisition, called when an acquisition is aborted or fails, stops sequence acquisition, clears the circular buffer, sets the default camera properties and resets the joystick

safe_state.description: None reached: the clone has no stage halt, so the e-stop sends nothing to the ASI console; the MHS latch refuses new commands while a move already sent continues to its target. reset_stage (RESET) is not sent: its docstring says it resets the console's flash memory, origin and joystick settings, it is marked deprecated, and it is sent only after the XY stage stops being busy (stage.py:51-57, 321-334).
